product.title: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount Bunk - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 7701
product.body_html:
The Cortech Endurance Wall Mounted Bunk, like the rest of Cortech's Endurance Series Furniture line, is ideal for continuous use in extreme environments, including compassionate and normative Behavioral Health Care Facilities, Residential Treatment Centers and Facilities, Hospital Psychiatric Units, Correctional Institutions, Mental Health Treatment Centers and other medical and public safety facilities that require the ultimate combination of durability and functional design.

  • Constructed of high impact no break polyethylene in a durable, one piece, rotationally molded design for increased strength
  • Space saving for double bunk use
  • Durable, one piece, rotationally molded design for increased strength. Constructed of high impact no break polyethylene. No steel or wood components
  • Stain resistant
  • Bolt to the wall via concealed pilot holes (hardware not included)
  • Easy to clean and maintain
  • Maintenance free
  • Passes 2000 lb. static load test
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133)
  • Options and accessories:
    • 7702 - Endurance Wall Bunk Safety Rail
    • 7703 - Endurance Wall Bunk Small Safety Rail
    • 7704 - Endurance Wall Bunk Ladder
  • Colors: 7701BK Black, 7701SB Slate Blue, 7701GN Green, 7701BN Brown, 7701BG Blue Gray
  • Made in the USA

About Cortech Endurance Furniture:
The Cortech Endurance intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture, correctional facility furniture, detention furniture, and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Endurance Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities, detention centers, correctional institutions, prisons and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
